newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Korea bounces back after Friday fall.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Korea bounces back after Friday fall.

text.p: Korean global depositary receipts resumed recent gains on Monday following profit-taking on Friday, traders said.
They said Friday's sharp correction had been overdone following Seoul's relatively steady close on Monday and gains on Saturday.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index added 4.59 points to 75.24 points, a premium of 45.01 percent over the local market.
The Seoul composite index rose 1.62 points to end the day at 758.39.
Indian GDRs edged higher in line with local market gains, with ITC adding 25 cents to $16.25/17.25 following strength in Bombay.
The James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.59 points up at 82.55, with the premium over the local market at 25.33 percent from 25.48 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index closed up 53.08 points to 3,808.18.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 4.32 points, or 3.76 percent, to 119.44, representing a discount to the local market of 2.06 percent.
